notes: All 15 discovery and diamond records independently audited against current official policies: 13 verified_free routes and 2 needs_verification. Fee audit is evidence review, not a submission-system transaction or venue confirmation.

Eight Sage subscription routes and five diamond routes remain verified. Scope is the compliant route stated in each record; optional open access, print color, offprints, optional services and third-party permissions remain separate from compulsory journal fees.

Acta Sociologica and Social Science Computer Review contain generic OA wording about additional page/color charges. Their journal-specific policy expressly excludes submission/publication fees, no actual page-fee schedule is stated, and neither appears in Sage's current active-charge list. This caveat is preserved; the stronger journal-specific statement supports the selected subscription route.

Computational and Mathematical Organization Theory remains pending: no-APC subscription publication is verified, but submission and all non-APC costs are not expressly settled. Generic Springer guidance does not establish an unconditional free route.

Network Science is wholly gold OA from 2024, with a current published no-funding waiver promise after acceptance. It is a conditional_waiver route, not subscription or diamond. An explicit zero-submission-fee statement was not located, so eligibility remains needs_verification.

M@n@gement is verified for manuscripts submitted in English; accepted French manuscripts require author-funded professional translation and copyediting. Sociológia's prohibition of AI-generated scholarly content remains a compatibility condition.

No compulsory society memberships, registrations or print purchases were identified for these journal routes. Absence in inspected text is described as such; unknown charges are not invented as either none or charged.

Ordinary HTTPS retrieval was used for complete official Sociologica, Przegląd Socjologiczny and selected other policies when useful; no credentials or access-control circumvention were used. SSCR live HTML failed, so a readable official publisher instructions PDF supplies the primary fee evidence.
No records were added, deleted or ranked; other agents' files and shared canonical data were not edited.
